inference: performance-informed exploratory cohort; not independent validation
reference: minimum of declared references and every finite saved benchmark/calibration/attempt value per identity_group
target: f_ref + tau * (f_initial - f_ref); first saved query meeting target
failed_run: retained; target attainment is credited if an observed query met the target
attempt: first completed attempt, otherwise latest terminal attempt; all attempts billed separately

eligibility.trivial_start_definition: any method reaches primary target within max(5,n+1) queries
eligibility.discriminating_start_definition: unequal success or largest/smallest successful first-hit >= 1.2

curvature_dispersion: offline finite-difference absolute Hessian spectral ratio if available, else declared structural evidence or axial central second-difference dispersion from NEWUOA-full first-start initialization; descriptive, not a certified condition number
duplicate_handling: keep distinct author-start configurations; exclude only verified cross-library duplicate entries with duplicate_of set
insufficient_eligible: save actual eligible count and explicit shortfall; never pad with invalid cases
profiles: each instance-start pair has equal weight, including failures; denominator is the full planned cohort
